home_badge: OAuth 2.1 and OIDC for your projects
home_description: Run a complete Better Auth server on your own infrastructure. PostgreSQL-backed sessions, organizations, OAuth, branded auth pages, and typed components are packaged into one deployable service.
home_methods_description: Start with a same-origin proxy, connect any standards-compatible client through OAuth, or give every product its own branded auth domain.
home_method_proxy_description: Keep first-party cookies on your app origin while Krakstack Auth owns credentials and sessions.
home_method_oauth_description: Use authorization code flow, PKCE, discovery metadata, and the OAuth library you already trust.
home_method_domain_description: Launch a dedicated, branded sign-in hostname linked to a project or organization.
home_platform_title: The hard auth work is connected and ready to run.
home_feature_sessions_description: Passwords, email codes, Google, TOTP, verification, recovery, and session controls.
home_feature_orgs_description: Shared users, memberships, roles, invitations, and active organization state.
home_feature_branding_description: Logos, shadcn CSS themes, sign-in methods, and custom hostnames per project.
home_feature_service_description: Effect HttpApi clients and service keys for trusted backend integrations.
home_cta_title: Own your auth without assembling it yourself.
home_cta_description: Review the deployment requirements, build for your own origin, connect PostgreSQL, and integrate your first application. Krakstack Auth is self-hosted software; no managed cloud service is currently offered.
home_footer: Open-source, self-hosted authentication built on Better Auth and PostgreSQL.
